correctness.rationale: For the displayed cactus c,a,b, the conjugates c^j b c^-j produce a family of transpositions sharing the fixed d point after canceling their common disjoint factor; their pairwise products produce all centered three-cycles and generate A on d+1 letters. Conjugating alternating subgroups by a and b adds the remaining three letters. The generator parity gives \(A_n\) for odd d and \(S_n\) for even d. The even symmetric construction is an explicit signed-pair cactus with local cycles 2k and (2,2), n-cycle product, and unsigned S_m together with a single flip, hence full \(C_2\wr S_m\). Riemann existence and the proved two braid-orbit classification transfer the representatives to all polynomials in their classes. The staged verify_monodromy.py executed exact group-order checks for d=3..14 and k=2..9. No infinite conclusion relies on this finite range.

originality.rationale: The precise new statement is the complete geometric monodromy-group trichotomy for the three branch-cycle topological classes in arXiv:2610.15550v1: \(A_{d+4}\) for odd d, \(S_{d+4}\) for even nonsymmetric, and full \(C_2\wr S_{(d+4)/2}\) for even quadratic-composite. The 2026 originating full text states the orbit and tropical-fan classification (Propositions 4.1, 4.5, 4.6), and provides a cactus representative, but does not calculate these three generated groups. Esterov treats generic coefficient systems, not the constrained critical-value passport; Behajaina--Konig--Neftin treat general lower bounds and possible exceptions of composition monodromy, not this exact trichotomy. Barquero-Sanchez--Calvo-Monge proves a wreath embedding, not equality. Targeted exact-phrase and alias searches and published-finding corpus searches found no statement implying the full new trichotomy. An implicit deduction by earlier experts remains possible, documented as residual risk.
residual_risks: An earlier exact geometric-group classification may be implicit in classical polynomial-cactus literature not indexed by the searches.
The broad composition papers were compared at their materially relevant theorems, not all 900+ lines of each work.
The wreath-embedding and 2024 arithmetic composition full texts were not inspected throughout; their abstracts alone cannot establish whole-paper noncoverage.

value.rationale: Geometric monodromy is an intrinsic algebraic invariant of a branched polynomial cover, and the source classification naturally prompts its calculation. The result completely separates three distinct infinite strata by Galois structure and, for even degrees with identical ramification passport, exposes a nontrivial primitive/imprimitive dichotomy. This gives a precise structural refinement of the 2026 orbit classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The signed-wreath equality is stronger than the general wreath embedding and composition kernel lower bounds. Uses an exact infinite proof rather than isolated tests.
